needs: commands.test in .factory/sandbox/manifest.json set to "npm test", so the tests gate runs the suite this PR adds instead of returning "no test command".
why: The manifest records commands.test as null and lists "Automated tests and total coverage" under capabilities.not_exercised, because the repo had no runner. This PR adds one: package.json now has a test script (`node --test "tests/**/*.test.js"`, node's built-in runner, no new dependency) and 25 HTTP tests over src/handlers.js, src/server.js and src/report.js. I ran them here and they pass, but bsf gates tests reads commands.test from the manifest, and .factory/sandbox/** is a protected path this pipeline may not change, so the gate still reports neutral/no_tests and the suite is not enforced until the manifest is amended. No new service, credential or stub is needed: the tests start the exported express app on an ephemeral port in-process, and npm ci already installs everything they use.
